﻿metadata:
  udi: prismata.prismatalabs.manifest
  name: PrismataLabs Application Manifest
  version: 0.3.1
  kind: application-manifest
  description: >
    PrismataLabs preview environment for colour-schemes, border-patterns,
    panes, menus, menu-items, and ui-frameworks. Provides a Python-first
    preview engine and structured menu-driven workflow. Updated menu schema
    version: 0.4.3.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Application Roots
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

paths:
  pythonBridge: "./python/python_bridge.py"
  capabilities: "./config/capability-manifest.yaml"
  projectMenus: "./config/project-menus"
  settings: "./config/labs.settings.yaml"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Preview Engine Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

preview:
  enable: true

  # Default preview roles
  defaultColourScheme: "default"
  defaultBorderPattern: "default"
  defaultUIFramework: "default"

  # Preview behaviour flags
  showBorder: true
  showColour: true
  showHeader: true
  showFooter: true

  # Multi-pane preview defaults
  multiPane:
    layout: "horizontal"
    maxWidth: 120
    maxHeight: 40

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Registry Roots (canonical Meta)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

registry:
  colourSchemes: "../../../Meta/registry/colour-scheme.d"
  colourRoles: "../../../Meta/registry/colour-role.d"
  borderPatterns: "../../../Meta/registry/border-pattern.d"
  uiFrameworks: "../../../Meta/registry/ui-framework.d"
  panes: "../../../Meta/registry/pane.d"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Manifest & Schema Roots
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

schemas:
  manifestSchemas: "../../../Meta/domain/manifest.schemas"
  objectSchemas: "../../../Meta/canonical/object.schemas"
  compositionSchemas: "../../../Meta/canonical/composition.schemas"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Application Behaviour
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

behaviour:
  allowDynamicHeader: true
  allowDynamicFooter: true
  allowConditionalVisibility: true
  allowConditionalEnablement: true
  allowMenuItemInjection: true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Universe2 Integration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

universeIntegration:
  ingestMenus: true
  ingestCapabilities: true
  ingestPreviewEngine: true
  submenuName: "PrismataLabs"
  submenuIcon: "ðŸ§ª"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PrismCommander Integration (future)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

prismCommander:
  ingestComponents: true
  ingestPreviewableObjects: true
  submenuName: "Labs2 Components"
  submenuIcon: "ðŸ”§"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diagnostics
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

diagnostics:
  enableLogging: true
  logFile: "./logs/labs2.log"
  showValidationErrors: true
  showPreviewMetadata: true
